compatibility_badge: PCB Layout Change Required (Pinout or Package Mismatch)

pin_diff.note: PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 1: AP7361C-33E-13 assigns IN (VIN) whereas AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1 assigns ADJ/GND (GND) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.
PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 2: AP7361C-33E-13 assigns GND (GND) whereas AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1 assigns OUTPUT (VOUT) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.
PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 3: AP7361C-33E-13 assigns OUT (VOUT) whereas AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1 assigns INPUT (VIN) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.

parameter_matrix.note: A part wins only if its operating Vin range strictly encompasses the counterpart on both ends.
Higher Vin,abs improves survivability against hot-plug and inductive bus spikes.
Tighter Vout tolerance improves ADC reference and digital rail margin.
Actual usable continuous Iout is also bounded by package θJA thermal derating.
Lower Iq directly extends sleep-mode battery life in always-on IoT/portable rails.
Lower dropout allows regulation deeper into Li-ion / 3.7 V discharge curves.
Non-ceramic-stable LDOs oscillate with low-ESR MLCCs unless series resistance or tantalum is used.
Higher PSRR attenuates upstream switching-converter ripple on analog/RF rails.
Critical for RF VCOs, low-noise ADCs, and precision sensor excitation.
Lower θJA yields lower junction temperature rise ΔTj = (Vin - Vout) × Iout × θJA.
Keep steady-state Tj at least 15–25 °C below Tj,max for production reliability.

swap_risks: CRITICAL PINOUT CONFLICT: Incompatible pin assignments on Pin 1 (VIN vs GND), Pin 2 (GND vs VOUT), Pin 3 (VOUT vs VIN). Soldering AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1 onto a AP7361C-33E-13 footprint (or vice versa) without rerouting copper can short VIN/VOUT/GND and permanently damage the board.
CRITICAL SHORT-CIRCUIT HAZARD: Exposed thermal pad/tab net conflict (GND vs VOUT) — direct swap will short power rails.
CAUTION OUTPUT CAPACITANCE: Minimum Cout differs by 4.5x (AP7361C-33E-13: 2.2 µF p.1 vs AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1: 10 µF p.3); account for MLCC DC-bias derating.
HIGH INPUT VOLTAGE RATING DROP: AP7361C-33E-13 is rated to only 6 V rec. (6.5 V abs max, p.4) vs AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1 at 15 V rec. (18 V abs max, p.4). Verify worst-case input transient spikes.
HIGH LOAD CURRENT DERATING: AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1 supplies up to 800 mA (p.7) compared to AP7361C-33E-13 at 1000 mA (p.4); confirm peak inrush and thermal dissipation margin.
CAUTION DROPOUT HEADROOM: Typical dropout differs (AP7361C-33E-13: 340 mV p.5 vs AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1: 1200 mV p.7); verify Vin,min - Vout >= Vdo across temperature and load corners.

HIGH ABSOLUTE-MAX SURGE MARGIN: AP7361C-33E-13 has a lower Vin,abs,max rating (6.5 V, p.4) than AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1 (18 V, p.4); verify hot-plug, inductive kickback, and TVS clamp peaks stay safely below 6.5 V.
HIGH MINIMUM SUPPLY FLOOR: AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1 requires Vin,min >= 4.8 V (p.7) vs 2.2 V on the counterpart; confirm low-battery / brown-out operation still clears the higher floor.

HIGH TEMPERATURE GRADE MISMATCH: Rated ambient range differs (AP7361C-33E-13: -40..85 °C Industrial (-40°C to +85°C TA, TJ up to +150°C) vs AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1: -20..125 °C Extended Commercial (-20°C to +125°C TJ — NOT -40°C Industrial)); AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1 cold limit only -20 °C, AP7361C-33E-13 hot limit only 85 °C — verify product ambient qualification before swapping.
engineering_verdict: AP7361C-33E-13 (Diodes Incorporated, SOT-223-3) and AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1 (Diodes Incorporated, SOT-223-3) are NOT drop-in interchangeable (Level 3 PCB Layout / Circuit Change Required) due to pinout mismatch on Pin 1 (VIN vs GND), Pin 2 (GND vs VOUT), Pin 3 (VOUT vs VIN); exposed pad / thermal tab net mismatch. Specific pin conflicts: Pin 1 (VIN vs GND), Pin 2 (GND vs VOUT), Pin 3 (VOUT vs VIN). Under a representative 5 V → 3.3 V rail at 150 mA (255 mW), estimated self-heating is ΔTj ≈ 28.1 °C on AP7361C-33E-13 (θJA 110 °C/W) vs 31.9 °C on AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1 (θJA 125 °C/W), while quiescent draw spans a 66.7x ratio (60 µA (p.5) vs 4000 µA (p.7)). Primary bench gotchas to watch: AP7361C-33E-13 "CRITICAL E vs. ER Suffix Pinout Trap — AP7361C-33E-13 is INCOMPATIBLE with 1117 Pads" (p.15) and AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1 "Operating Temperature Stops at -20°C — NOT Rated for -40°C Industrial Grade" (p.4). BOM decision: Choose AP7361C-33E-13 when load current exceeds 800 mA (up to 1000 mA) or battery sleep budget demands 60 µA Iq; choose AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1 when input rails climb above 6 V (rated to 15 V). Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.1 vs TOP_VIEW p.2) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
